title: PosFullSchedule

additionalProperties.description: The status of a merchant as related to the schedule.

statuses.description: A map of all schedule types (`DELIVERY`, `PICKUP`, etc.) and their current open/close status.

today_schedule.description:
A collection of the types of schedules for a merchant, the date on which they begin, and the number of days in each schedule's period. Together, this collection defines the outlines of a merchant's pickup and delivery schedules.
Note that the first field, name, is used as the index of the collection.

overrides_in_effect.description: The schedules overrides that currently apply to the various schedule types in effect for this merchant.

mass_overrides_in_effect.description: The schedule overrides that apply to this and several other merchants, usually of the same merchant group.

repeating_schedules_in_effect.description: Any repeating weekly schedules in effect for this merchant.

custom_schedules_in_effect.description: Any custom, temporary schedules currently in place. These will take precedence over a repeating schedule of the same type.

all_schedule_overrides.description: All previous, current, and future schedule overrides associated with this merchant.

all_mass_overrides.description: All mass schedule overrides that have or could affect this merchant's schedule.

all_repeating_schedules.description: All weekly repeating schedules associated with this merchant. These are used as the default schedule when no custom schedules, or unavailable/available overrides are in effect.

all_custom_schedules.description: All custom schedules associated with this merchant. These are temporary schedules that change the working hours for the merchant for things like holiday or summer hours.

managed_delivery_schedules.description: The managed delivery schedules for the region that includes this merchant's address.

description: Complete schedule information about the merchant, including the status of any alternate schedules or overrides.

updated_by.description: The last credential to update the schedule

created_date.description: The creation date of the schedule

updated_date.description: The last update date of the schedule

legacy_id.description: The legacy ID of the schedule in MySQL

source.description: The source of the creation or update of the custom schedule

intervals.description: A set of non-overlapping time periods

CustomScheduleMetadata.description: The metadata associated to a specific custom schedule

name_filter.description: Optional Java Regular Expression used to target specific RepeatingSchedules by name

override_type.description: The type of a schedule override.  Describes whether the deviation is to open or close unexpectedly.

schedule_type.description: The type of mass schedule override, whether timezones are applied

name.description: Type of schedule. If not specified, defaults to "DELIVERY"

PosCustomSchedule.description: All custom schedules associated with this merchant. These are temporary schedules that change the working hours for the merchant for things like holiday or summer hours.

id.description: The identifier of the mass override itself.

merchant_ids.description: The IDs of the merchants affected by this mass blackout.

items.description: The IDs of the merchants affected by this mass blackout.

start_time_utc.description: The date and time when this mass override begins in the UTC (Coordinated Universal Time) time zone.

end_time_utc.description: The date and time when this mass override ends in the UTC (Coordinated Universal Time) time zone.

start_time_local.description: The date and time when this mass override begins in the merchant's local time zone.

end_time_local.description: The date and time when this mass override ends in the merchant's local time zone.

PosMassScheduleOverride.description: Information about a blackout that applies to multiple merchants; used for groups of merchants to halt online orders or pause ordering during a disaster (Grubhub administrative use only).

merchant_id.description: The Grubhub or third-party provided external ID for the merchant.

name.description: Type of schedule. If not specified, defaults to "DELIVERY"

version_id.description: The ID of the version of this schedule which changes upon updates to the schedule.

PosMerchantRepeatingSchedule.description: The repeating weekly schedule of a merchant.

merchant_id.description: The Grubhub or third-party provided external ID for the merchant.

name.description: Type of schedule. If not specified, defaults to "DELIVERY"

type.description: Type of schedule override. "UNAVAILABLE" is a duration when the merchant should be closed, when normally they would be open. "AVAILABLE" is a duration when the merchant should be open, when normally they would be closed.

local_start_time.description: The time in the merchant's timezone when the override duration starts.

local_end_time.description: The time in the merchant's timezone when the override duration ends.

start_time_utc.description: The UTC time when the override duration starts.

end_time_utc.description: The UTC time when the override duration ends.

PosScheduleOverride.description: Schedule Override for a merchant. Schedule overrides are ad hoc modifications to a merchant's normal hours of operation on Grubhub.

external_id.description: The merchant-set ID for this schedule, which can be used to link it in the `PosNormalizedMenu`.

name.description: The display name for this schedule, e.g. "Sunday Brunch"

type.description: How often this schedule repeats. Currently the only valid value is "WEEKLY".

rules.description: A set of non-overlapping time periods.

RepeatingSchedule.description: Information about a weekly schedule during which a menu item may be made available. Typical usages include Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, Weekend Brunch, etc.

days.description: Days of the week for which the time period applies. Must be one of [MONDAY, TUESDAY, WEDNESDAY, THURSDAY, FRIDAY, SATURDAY, SUNDAY]

items.description: Days of the week for which the time period applies. Must be one of [MONDAY, TUESDAY, WEDNESDAY, THURSDAY, FRIDAY, SATURDAY, SUNDAY]

start_time.description: The time when this schedule begins on the days listed, in the merchant's local time. Must conform to ISO date and time format

end_time.description: The time when this schedule ends on the days listed, in the merchant's local time. Must conform to ISO date and time format
